key.name: style
key.summary: Island shape
key.description: "notch" sits flush with the top edge with rounded bottom corners; "floating" is a fully rounded pill detached from the edge.

key.name: bg-opacity
key.summary: Background opacity

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels

key.name: island-height
key.summary: Island height in pixels

key.name: top-gap
key.summary: Gap above the island, floating style only

key.name: side-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding inside the island

key.name: reclaim-space
key.summary: Give the panel's reserved strip back to the windows
key.description: On, windows fill the whole screen height and the island overlays them. Off, the panel reserves its height as GNOME normally does, so nothing is ever covered.

key.name: hide-activities
key.summary: Hide the Activities button
key.description: The overview is still reachable with the Super key.

key.name: island-blur
key.summary: Frost the island with a background blur
key.description: Uses Shell.BlurEffect in BACKGROUND mode. Lower the background opacity for the blur to show through.

key.name: blur-radius
key.summary: Blur radius

key.name: blur-brightness
key.summary: Blur brightness

key.name: keep-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Keep the island visible over fullscreen windows
key.description: GNOME registers the panel with trackFullscreen, so it normally hides whenever a window covers the whole monitor. This clears that flag for the panel only.

key.name: fix-dock-fullscreen
key.summary: Let the dock reveal on hover over fullscreen windows
key.description: dash2dock-lite refuses to slide in, and stops its render loop, whenever the monitor counts as fullscreen -- which a maximized window now does, since the panel no longer reserves space. This neutralises those guards for the duration of each call, without modifying that extension.

key.name: autohide-mode
key.summary: When the island should hide itself and wait for a hover
key.description: Mirrors the macOS menu bar: "fullscreen" hides only over a genuinely fullscreen window, which is the only case macOS hides for. Mutter does not report a merely maximized window as fullscreen, however large it is, so "fullscreen-and-maximized" tests the window state directly.

key.name: reveal-edge
key.summary: Height in pixels of the strip at the top that brings the island back
key.description: Roughly where the island itself sits, so the gesture is "move to the notch". Three pixels was unhittable with a mouse. It spans the island's width only and is reactive solely while the island is hidden, so the window buttons in the corners stay clickable.

key.name: hide-delay
key.summary: Delay in milliseconds before the island slides away again

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Slide duration in milliseconds

key.name: expand-on-hover
key.summary: Bloom open into a panel when hovered
key.description: The panel is a separate actor that opens beneath the island, because the panel's own centre box cannot grow past the panel height.

key.name: expand-delay
key.summary: Delay in milliseconds before hovering opens the panel

key.name: event-capsules
key.summary: Let events take the island over briefly

key.name: event-dwell
key.summary: How long the full capsule stays before it draws in, in milliseconds

key.name: event-compact-dwell
key.summary: How long the compact capsule lingers afterwards, in milliseconds

key.name: events-notifications
key.summary: Show a capsule for notifications

key.name: events-power
key.summary: Show a capsule when the charger is plugged in or out

key.name: events-bluetooth
key.summary: Show a capsule when a Bluetooth device connects

key.name: events-timer
key.summary: Show a capsule when a focus session ends

key.name: replace-banners
key.summary: Use the capsule instead of GNOME's own notification banner

key.name: event-sounds
key.summary: Play a sound with each capsule

key.name: events-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Show capsules over fullscreen windows

key.name: active-pane
key.summary: Pane shown when the island unfolds

key.name: shelf-width
key.summary: Width of the expanded panel in pixels

key.name: all-monitors
key.summary: Put an island on every monitor
key.description: The shell has a single panel, so only the primary monitor can host the real clock and control centre. Secondary monitors get a matching island showing the time, with the same hover behaviour.

key.name: reveal-margin
key.summary: Extra width on each side of the hover strip
key.description: The strip spans the island's width plus this margin, instead of the whole screen, so the window buttons in the top corners stay reachable.

key.name: concave-corners
key.summary: Flare the island's top corners into the screen edge
key.description: The curve is concave, which border-radius cannot express, so each corner is a small St.DrawingArea filled with Cairo and kept in step with the island as it grows.

key.name: focus-seconds
key.summary: Length of a focus session, in seconds

key.name: ring-dots
key.summary: Number of dots around the timer ring
key.description: Each dot stands for the session length divided by this count, and goes dark once its share has elapsed. A fixed count rather than one dot per minute, so the ring stays readable at any duration.
